verdict.rationale: Restate's own docs say you can "export traces" from agent execution, and its Introspection SQL API and CLI expose invocation status. That gives some telemetry export toward an observability stack, which could cover latencies. Nothing in the evidence covers metrics for failure rates or queue depths, or any alerting. Missing for 10: documented metrics export (e.g. failure rates, latencies, queue depths) to external observability tools, alerting when workflows misbehave, trace-export setup details, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, failure rates, latencies, and queue depths export to my observability stack, and alerts fire when workflows misbehave

citations.quote: Full visibility into agent execution. Inspect journals, export traces, and cancel or kill stuck agents.
Restate exposes information on invocations and application state via its CLI and Introspection SQL API.
Trace and monitor your Restate AI agents with Langfuse.
